title: Be whole with Ardhanarishvara
line: For wholeness: the Lord who is half woman, Shiva and Shakti in one body.
intro: Ardhanarishvara is Shiva and Shakti as one form: the right half Shiva, the left half Parvati, joined down the middle. For many, especially queer and gender-diverse people, the form says something simple and deep: that the sacred is not divided into male and female, and neither are you.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.text: Breathe into both sides of the body equally.

steps.title: The salutation
steps.text: A simple salutation to the whole form.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.text: Repeat it, and let it settle in the whole body.

steps.title: Wholeness
steps.prompt: A part of myself I have kept apart, that I could welcome back.

steps.title: Close
steps.text: Close with a blessing for all beings.

after: You are not half of anything.
